content: Open VSX versioned file URL is https://open-vsx.org/api/{namespace}/{name}/{version}/file/{id}-{version}.vsix (matches in-tree openVsxFileUrl); registry API exposes /{namespace}/{extension}/{targetPlatform}/{version} routes; target-specific files take namespace.name-version@target.vsix form; no lockfile or hash API — pin is exact version string plus out-of-band sha256.
